==Hero Usage==

* For certain purposes, heroes only use this skill when above 75% energy:
** Removing conditions/hexes
** General healing outside of combat
* They use it regardless of energy as a general heal in combat, and emergency heal out of combat.

==Notes==
*This skill has the shortest recharge time amongst all skills that can remove a hex, not counting [[Inspired Hex]] and [[Revealed Hex]] (those two skills are replaced for 20 seconds unless a monster-only hex spell was removed).
*Very useful at providing a lot of utility in a single skill slot and with a short recharge, however the energy consumption of this skill is considerable if used a lot.

== Trivia ==
* The functionality of this skill has changed since its introduction; see its [[/Skill History|skill revision history]] for details.
